chapter_title: The Theft of the Rimet Cup
title: Out of the Blue
subtitle: One ticket for multiple shows, you don't get such a good bargain everyday.

items.text: The eyes of the puppy shine indigo. He moves agilely and swiftly, avoiding all robots.
This time, Pickles really hopes his instinct doesn't work.
He rushes into the room at the end of the corridor.
The screens of the CCTV light up in blue. Every corner of the exhibition hall is shown in front of them.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: How do you find this place at a glance? Have you been here?

items.speaker: Pickles
items.text: Woof.

items.speaker: "Doggie"
items.text: The puppy expresses his modesty.
APPLe notices the microphone on the table.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: The mission assigned by Captain progresses smoothly. We have a whole set of broadcasting equipment here.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Hmm. Then we only need to install a corresponding frequency interference device. Captain Regulus can fully control all radio channels within the radius of 5km.
Pickles skims each screen quickly.
As Pickles stares, two sneaking figures open up the ceiling and quickly disappear in the duct.

items.speaker: Pickles
items.text: Woof …

items.speaker: Pickles
items.text: Woof woof! Woooof!

items.speaker: Pickles
items.text: Woof woof.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Hmm?
The hall is the most crowded place, with visitors chatting loudly. The world here is so chaotic.

items.speaker: Iverson
items.text: Oh! Bloody hell!

items.speaker: Iverson
items.text: Who let this plushy monster in!

items.speaker: Iverson
items.text: Achoo!

items.speaker: Iverson
items.text: Now this whole place is contaminated by disgusting fur. Atishoo!
A furious man walks towards Pickles.
He keeps pressing the button again and again.

items.speaker: Pickles
items.text: Woof?

items.speaker: Pickles
items.text: Woof woof! Woof woof …

items.speaker: Iverson
items.text: Robots! Where are my robots?

items.speaker: Iverson
items.text: Drive it out! Atishoo!

items.speaker: Security Robot
items.text: Command received.
The cold-blooded iron robot gets close to Pickles and shows him the threatening taser.

items.speaker: Pickles
items.text: Woof woof?

items.speaker: Pickles
items.text: Woof.

items.speaker: Security Robot
items.text: He shines with a glorious halo. The indigo light on him overwhelms the robot, just like sharp swords.

items.speaker: Security Robot
items.text: Beep beep! Beep beep!

items.speaker: Security Robot
items.text: Alert, alert! Unknown energy detected!
Bang!
The robot suddenly stops. The meter number fluctuates as if it's affected by a mysterious force.

items.speaker: Pickles
items.text: Woof woof …

items.speaker: Iverson
items.text: What's wrong? You broke down?
More and more robots are approaching.

items.speaker: Security Robot
items.text: Risk rating: ★★★★☆

items.speaker: Security Robot
items.text: Request support! Request support!

items.speaker: Iverson
items.text: Terrible plushy monster! It-It must be a terrorist! We must put it down right now!

items.speaker: Iverson
items.text: All of you! Drive it out. No, no, no. Put it down!

items.speaker: Pickles
items.text: Woof woof, woof woof.
The chaos arouses the attention of more visitors, but Iverson doesn't seem to care about it.

items.speaker: Iverson
items.text: Achoo!

items.speaker: Iverson
items.text: DEFCON III!

items.speaker: Pickles
items.text: Woof ... woof …
A man violently pushes his way through the crowd and stands next to Pickles.

items.speaker: Charlton
items.text: What are you doing?!

items.speaker: Charlton
items.text: Get away from my Pickles!

items.speaker: Iverson
items.text: It's you who brought it in.

items.speaker: Iverson
items.text: I now warn you! Your dog is a bloody, hazardous uncertainty, and we must put it down!

items.speaker: Charlton
items.text: What a humbug!

items.speaker: Charlton
items.text: He's not hazardous at all! Every one of our neighbours loves him! Let's go!

items.speaker: Iverson
items.text: Achoo!

items.speaker: Iverson
items.text: You don't have a voice here. You can't leave, either.
The alarming robots surround Charlton and Pickles.

items.speaker: Pickles
items.text: Woof …

items.speaker: Iverson
items.text: According to Item 5, Article 172 of the Guidance on Security, security companies have the right to directly deal with any dangerous items when on duty.

items.speaker: Iverson
items.text: I command you to hand me your dog!

items.speaker: Iverson
items.text: As compensation, we will buy you a more purebred and more friendly dog for helping us wipe out risks.

items.speaker: Iverson
items.text: Don't lose your mind to a pet dog. Atishoo!

items.speaker: Pickles
items.text: Woof woof.

items.speaker: Pickles
items.text: Woof …
Charlton rushes to Pickles, stretches out his arms, and angrily stares at the cold-blooded "iron monster" in front of him.

items.speaker: Charlton
items.text: What the hell are you talking about? He's my friend!

items.speaker: Charlton
items.text: You crazy bastard! Would you ever leave your friend alone?

items.speaker: Charlton
items.text: Oh, fine. Maybe you would. You cold-blooded prat! Dead from the neck up!

items.speaker: Pickles
items.text: Woof …

items.speaker: Iverson
items.text: If you don't want to be put onto the World Cup audience blacklist, I kindly request you to stop what you are doing.

items.speaker: Charlton
items.text: Very well done. But I'll tell you what, you can't threaten me! I'm definitely not leaving Pickles alone!

items.speaker: Charlton
items.text: Go f**k your World Cup!

items.speaker: Iverson
items.text: Ha! What a fool.
He presses the red button.

items.speaker: Iverson
items.text: Catch them!
The security robots quickly react.
Charlton fearlessly runs to the robots like a brave matador in a red cape.
The security robots take back the sedative spray.
Iverson is very pleased with their performance.

items.speaker: Iverson
items.text: Finally ... Atishoo!

items.speaker: Iverson
items.text: Turn the ventilation system to the highest mode. I don't want any dog fur here! Other robots, go catch that dog!

items.speaker: Security Robot
items.text: Command confirmed.
Pickles sniffs Charlton, who is in a coma.

items.speaker: Pickles
items.text: Woof woof ... woof.
The robots get closer and closer. Pickles notices the remote control in Iverson's hand.

items.speaker: Pickles
items.text: Woof, woof.
All the fans in the hall are switched on. They're spinning faster and faster.
Suddenly, there's a strange noise from the ceiling.

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: Hey, hey! What's going on here?

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: What have you done?

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Not me. Th-The ventilation system suddenly started to work!

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: This is the perfect plan you told me?

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: We are going to be blown out!

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Hey! Slow down!

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: It's too late! Crash warning! Whoaaaaaa!

items.speaker: Iverson
items.text: Haahh!!

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: Um, hi!
TO BE CONTINUED ...
